messages:
aline: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we agreed to publish a temporary SLO amendment for text-gen while we ship fixes. Need owners, exact rollback signals, and milestone dates before sprint planning.

rahul: I'll own the SLO wording & customer blurb. Draft: text-gen p99 <= 300ms (30-day rolling), throughput p95 >= 120 qps/shard during business hours. Temporary for 21 days, contingent on dashboards+rollback automation.

casey: I'll take dashboards and alerts. Plan: add per-shard p50/p90/p99, shard-qps, and a 7-day error-budget burn panel. Will push JSON and screenshots to ticket in 48h.

aline: Rollback triggers we discussed: auto rollback if error-budget burn > 20% in 24h OR sustained p99 > 600ms for >10m. Also fallback routing to smaller model if p99 > 500ms for 5m. Please add exact PromQL and tie them to alerts.

rahul: PromQL draft for error-budget burn (1h): (sum(increase(requests_total{route="text-gen",status!~"5.."}[1h])) / sum(increase(requests_total{route="text-gen"}[1h]))) < 0.98
Will add to ticket.

casey: Draft p99 spike alert (5m): histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="text-gen"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.30
Will tune after staging repro.

aline: Milestones: dashboards+alerts by 2048008640 (48h), rollback automation by 2048050000 (3 days), runtime PRs opened by 2048630000 (10 days). Add a 15m weekly review for the first 3 weeks post-deploy.

pager-bot: Created ticket SRE-9009: "pm/slo-amendment-text-gen-followup" with checklist and owners.

rahul: I'll draft the public-facing SLO amendment and route to legal once dashboards and rollback automation are in the ticket.

aline: Thanks everyone 8077; update SRE-9009 with exact rollback steps and signal definitions so I can approve before sprint planning.
